slice: KinTale GPS route stats + reliable delivery receipt: surface real GpsSummary distance/duration under RouteMap on the report screen (currently id-only) and on the composer (currently map-only, no stats), and make the WEB/DESKTOP send pipeline reliably write deliveryReceiptId (currently always "") so the DeliveryPanel SUGGESTION tag can drop on all three platforms.
summary: The SENT KinTale report and the composer will both render the shared RouteMap with real Distance/Duration stats sourced from the session's persisted GpsSummary (baked on session-end in Auntie Time via buildGpsSummary), replacing the report's id-only GPS string and adding stats under the composer map. The web and desktop send pipeline will dispatch the report_sent notification via the existing dispatchVisitNotification callable and write its first dispatchId as deliveryReceiptId with sentVia="catalog" (matching Android), after which the Delivery panel's SUGGESTION pill is removed on web, desktop, and Android since the receipt is now reliably populated.
alreadyExists:
- buildGpsSummary + saveSessionGpsSummary already bake a GpsSummary onto kin_care_sessions on DEPARTED: web/composeApp/src/commonMain/.../screens/sessions/KinCareSessionsScreen.kt:177-206 (stopGpsFor) and :876-893 (buildGpsSummary). GpsSummary model: FirestoreClient.kt:1235-1254 (distanceMeters/durationSeconds/route/computedAt).
- Shared web RouteMap ALREADY renders Distance/Duration/Pings stats from breadcrumbs: web .../screens/sessions/RouteMap.kt:50-53 (signature breadcrumbs: List<Breadcrumb>), :165-174 (Stat row), :194-237 (totalDistanceMeters/durationMillis/formatDistance/formatDuration).
- Composer already renders RouteMap (no stats gap actually: RouteMap shows stats) from breadcrumbsStream: KinTaleComposeScreen.kt:735-747 (GpsRouteBlock).
- ANDROID IS THE REFERENCE and already fully done for GPS stats: KinCareSession.gpsSummary field exists (android .../data/model/Models.kt:303), GpsSummary model LocationModels.kt:13-22, report VM reads session.gpsSummary.route (KinTaleReportViewModel.kt:105), GpsRouteSection renders RouteMap which shows Distance/Duration/Pings (android .../ui/components/RouteMap.kt:57-58,166-174). Android send already writes a real receipt: KinTaleReportViewModel.kt:310-329 (notifier.notify REPORT_SENT then markReportSent sentVia="catalog", deliveryReceiptId=firstDispatchId), repo markReportSent AuntieRepository.kt:1071-1080, VisitNotifier.kt:35-69 (calls dispatchVisitNotification, returns dispatchIds).
- Backend dispatch callable already returns dispatchIds: MyTribe functions/src/admin/dispatchVisitNotification.ts:38-135 (onCall + wrapAdminCallable + zod + enqueueNotification + writeAuditEntry; returns { ok, dispatchIds, suppressed }). report_sent event key kincare.report.sent already mapped (line 35).
- Web report Delivery panel already renders sentAt/sentVia/deliveryReceiptId, just tagged SUGGESTION: KinTaleReportScreen.kt:546-568. Web report GPS block is id-only string: KinTaleReportScreen.kt:340-357.
- platformInvokeCallable is real on web wasm + desktop jvm (JvmFirestoreRest.callable / JS bridge): FirestoreClient.kt:633; jvm FirestoreInterop.jvm.kt:302-304; wasm FirestoreInterop.wasmJs.kt:1055.

backend.plan: REUSE the existing dispatchVisitNotification callable (MyTribe functions/src/admin/dispatchVisitNotification.ts:132-135) for the report_sent event; it already does onCall + wrapAdminCallable + zod (EventArg includes 'report_sent', line 12) + enqueueNotification + writeAuditEntry and returns { ok, dispatchIds, suppressed }. Android already calls it. No new Cloud Function is required. The ONLY backend-adjacent change is client-side: the web/desktop send path must (1) invoke this callable (via platformInvokeCallable name='dispatchVisitNotification' with JSON { familyId=session.kinfolkId, bookingId=session.sourceBookingId, event='report_sent' }) and (2) pass the first returned dispatchId into the existing markKinTaleReportSent write as deliveryReceiptId with sentVia='catalog'. NOTE the existing web markKinTaleReportSent JS bridge writes status:'SENT' (firebase-bridge.js:282) while JVM writes status:'sent' (FirestoreInterop.jvm.kt:234) -- align both to 'SENT' so the report screen's status=='SENT' check (KinTaleReportScreen.kt:109,164) works on desktop too. No audit/notify gap: dispatchVisitNotification already writes NOTIFICATION_DISPATCHED audit (ts:112-119). For the GPS read: web KinCareSession has NO gpsSummary field -- add `val gpsSummary: GpsSummary? = null` to the web data class (FirestoreClient.kt:735-767, mirroring android Models.kt:303) so the existing sessionsStream() deserialization (FirestoreClient.kt:33) hydrates the already-persisted gpsSummary map; no new read callable needed.

frontend.changes: 1) FirestoreClient.kt: add `val gpsSummary: GpsSummary? = null` to data class KinCareSession (after visitRouteId, ~:754) mirroring android. Add a helper on FirestoreClient `fun sessionForIdStream(sessionId): Flow<FirestoreResult<KinCareSession?>>` derived from sessionsStream().map { firstOrNull{it._id==sessionId} } (same pattern as reportForSessionStream :243-252). Add a common adapter `internal fun GpsSummary.toBreadcrumbs(): List<Breadcrumb>` that maps route GpsPoint{lat,lng,t} -> Breadcrumb (epochMs t -> ISO timestamp) so the existing RouteMap(breadcrumbs) can render the persisted summary; place near GpsSummary (:1235). 2) KinTaleReportViewModel.kt: add `fun sessionStream() = dataSource.sessionForIdStream(sessionId)` (mirrors mediaStream :72-73). 3) KinTaleReportScreen.kt: collect sessionStream via the P0-FLICKER remember{}.collectAsState idiom (like :88-91); REPLACE the id-only GPS DenPanel (:340-357) with: when session.gpsSummary has a non-empty route -> render shared RouteMap(breadcrumbs = summary.toBreadcrumbs(), live=false) (which already shows Distance/Duration/Pings, RouteMap.kt:165-174); else if report.visitRouteId non-blank -> keep the id-only mono render as fallback; else hide. Do NOT fabricate stats when route is empty (fail-loud-by-omission). 4) KinTaleComposeScreen.kt GpsRouteBlock (:735-747): the shared RouteMap it calls already renders the Distance/Duration stats, so the composer 'no stats' gap is satisfied once RouteMap is confirmed; no literal change needed beyond confirming stats are visible (the mock's 'pace' is intentionally omitted per spec 10 item 5 since no pace field exists). 5) DeliveryPanel (:546-568): once the receipt is reliably written, REMOVE the `trailing = { AuntieStatusPill('SUGGESTION'...) }` so the panel renders untagged; keep the blank-field skips.

Rework platformSendReport (FirestoreInterop.wasmJs.kt:564-579) so it no longer passes deliveryReceiptId="" (:571). New flow: the SEND path must dispatch then mark. Because platformSendReport only receives reportId, move receipt orchestration up: either (a) change platformSendReport to also accept sessionId + the dispatch is done in commonMain VM, OR (b, preferred, smallest blast radius) have the VM (commonMain) call platformInvokeCallable('dispatchVisitNotification', json{familyId,bookingId,event:'report_sent'}) to get dispatchIds, then call the existing markKinTaleReportSent(reportId, sessionId, sentVia='catalog', deliveryReceiptId=firstDispatchId) path (jsMarkKinTaleReportSent bridge already takes deliveryReceiptId, :86,275-297). Update platformSendReport to be removed/bypassed in favor of the dispatch+mark sequence so deliveryReceiptId is real. The JS bridge markKinTaleReportSent (firebase-bridge.js:281-287) already writes deliveryReceiptId from its arg; keep status:'SENT' (already correct, :282). No bridge signature change needed if reusing markKinTaleReportSent.

platformMarkKinTaleReportSent (FirestoreInterop.jvm.kt:233-234) already PATCHes status/sentVia/sentAt/deliveryReceiptId via JvmFirestoreRest -- it writes whatever deliveryReceiptId arg it gets, so once the commonMain VM dispatches and passes a real id, desktop is covered. TWO fixes: (a) change the patched status literal from 'sent' to 'SENT' (:234) to match the wasm bridge and the report screen's status=='SENT' check; (b) platformSendReport at :241 is a stub (stubWriteResult 'runs server-side; use the web app') -- the dispatch+mark sequence (using platformInvokeCallable which is REAL on jvm via JvmFirestoreRest.callable, :302-304, and platformMarkKinTaleReportSent) makes desktop send actually work, so the SUGGESTION drop and receipt are real on desktop. platformSaveSessionGpsSummary stays stub (:296) because GPS capture is mobile-only, but the READ of an already-baked gpsSummary works through sessionsStream REST deserialization once the web model field is added -- no jvm change needed for the GPS read.

GPS stats: ALREADY DONE -- GpsRouteSection (:725-748) renders RouteMap(points) which shows Distance/Duration/Pings (ui/components/RouteMap.kt:166-174) from session.gpsSummary.route (VM :105). No change. Delivery receipt: send already writes a real deliveryReceiptId=firstDispatchId via dispatchVisitNotification (KinTaleReportViewModel.kt:310-329). The ONLY android change for this slice is parity on the SUGGESTION drop: Android currently has NO Delivery panel rendered in the SENT view (the report screen shows Recipients + VisitMeta at :276-278 but no DeliveryPanel). Add a DeliveryPanel composable (mirroring web KinTaleReportScreen.kt:546-568: Sent at / Sent via / Receipt rows from report.sentAt/sentVia/deliveryReceiptId) rendered after VisitMetaPanel (:278) WITHOUT a SUGGESTION pill, so android reaches parity with the now-untagged web/desktop Delivery panel. Skip blank fields (fail-loud-by-omission).

errorHandling: GPS read: when session.gpsSummary is null or route is empty, render NOTHING for stats (or fall back to id-only on web) -- never fabricate 1.4 mi / 32 min (spec 11 item 5 / spec 10 item 5 Rule 1). Send/dispatch: the dispatch callable failure must surface fail-loud. Web/desktop: the VM send() already routes errors to vm.error and the DraftEditorAndActions AuntieBanner (KinTaleReportScreen.kt:208-215); if dispatchVisitNotification returns WriteResult.Err, set error='Sent, but delivery receipt unavailable: <msg>' OR (matching Android which proceeds only onSuccess) treat dispatch failure as a hard send failure and do NOT flip to SENT, so the auntie retries -- mirror Android's onFailure path (KinTaleReportViewModel.kt:331-337) which sets error and leaves status DRAFT. Android dispatch already wraps runCatching with AuntieLog.e (VisitNotifier.kt:69). No silent swallow: dispatchVisitNotification itself throws HttpsError on missing familyId/primaryUid (dispatchVisitNotification.ts:50-76) which propagates as WriteResult.Err. suppressed=true (no channels) still yields a sent report but empty receipt -> the Delivery panel simply omits the Receipt row (blank-skip), which is honest, not faked.

tests.unit: WEB jvmTest (new file web/composeApp/src/jvmTest/.../kintales/GpsSummaryAdapterTest.kt): test GpsSummary.toBreadcrumbs maps lat/lng/t correctly, empty route -> empty list, single point, and t epochMs->ISO round-trip; and that the existing RouteMap helpers totalDistanceMeters/durationMillis/formatDistance/formatDuration produce expected values for the adapted breadcrumbs (reuse RouteMap.kt:194-237). ANDROID test/.../ui/components/RouteMapTest.kt ALREADY covers totalDistanceMeters/durationMillis/formatDistance -- extend with a 2-point happy case + 0/1-point sad cases if missing.
tests.integration: WEB jvmTest: extend a KinTaleReportViewModel/data-source test with a fake AuntieDataSource exposing sessionForIdStream emitting a KinCareSession with a populated gpsSummary -> assert the report shows route stats; and a session with null gpsSummary + non-blank visitRouteId -> assert id-only fallback; null+blank -> hidden. Send path: fake platformInvokeCallable('dispatchVisitNotification') returning {dispatchIds:['n8n_123']} -> assert markKinTaleReportSent is called with deliveryReceiptId='n8n_123', sentVia='catalog'; sad: callable returns {dispatchIds:[]} -> receipt blank, report still SENT (suppressed); error: callable WriteResult.Err -> report stays DRAFT + error banner string set. Use JvmFirestoreFixtures.callableResponses (FirestoreInterop.jvm.kt:303) to inject the fake dispatch response on desktop.
tests.ui: ANDROID Robolectric (android/app/src/test/.../ui/kintales/): compose-rule test that the SENT report renders the GPS RouteMap Distance/Duration stats when gpsSummary.route is non-empty, and renders the new DeliveryPanel rows (Sent via / Receipt) WITHOUT a 'SUGGESTION' pill when deliveryReceiptId is present, and omits the Receipt row when blank. Extend existing KinTaleReportViewModelTest.kt for the send->markReportSent(deliveryReceiptId=firstDispatchId) assertion (happy) + dispatch onFailure leaves status DRAFT (sad). WEB: RETIRED PATH (2026-07-31), the visual/golden harness and its jvmTest DemoFixtures are deleted; assert instead in the React admin's own suite that the report GPS panel shows a map+stats and the Delivery panel has no SUGGESTION pill in the SENT fixture.
tests.e2e: WEB Playwright (hermetic harness, docs/2026-05-31-visual-testing-design.md): drive the functions-emulator full-local shim to register a fake dispatchVisitNotification returning a deterministic dispatchId; seed a SENT kin_care_report + a kin_care_sessions doc with a baked gpsSummary; screenshot the report screen and assert (a) GPS RouteMap + Distance/Duration visible, (b) Delivery panel shows the receipt id and no SUGGESTION pill. Re-baseline the report golden hermetically (no prod callables). DESKTOP: Roborazzi golden for the same SENT fixture. If wiring a live dispatch in Playwright is infeasible, stub the callable at the emulator shim (consistent with the existing hermetic-harness rule) rather than hitting prod.

risks: 1) Status-literal mismatch: JVM markKinTaleReportSent writes status:'sent' (lowercase) but the report screen checks status=='SENT'; if not aligned, desktop sends would never flip to the SENT artifact view -- fix to 'SENT' on jvm. 2) Web platformSendReport currently does the mark with sessionId=\"\" and deliveryReceiptId=\"\" (FirestoreInterop.wasmJs.kt:569-571); the new flow must pass the real sessionId (needed by the JS bridge which requires sessionId, firebase-bridge.js:276) AND the dispatch id -- the VM must thread sessionId through, which it has (vm.sessionId). 3) dispatchVisitNotification requires session.sourceBookingId + kinfolkId; legacy/orphan or non-booking sessions will throw failed-precondition -- send must surface that fail-loud and not silently send with an empty receipt; decide (matching Android) to block the SENT flip on dispatch failure. 4) GpsSummary.toBreadcrumbs loses real timestamps if t==0 (older summaries) -> durationMillis returns 0 and formatDuration shows '-'; acceptable honest degradation, not a fake. 5) Web KinCareSession gaining a nested gpsSummary object must deserialize via the REST/JS path that already handles nested maps (sessionsStream); verify ignoreUnknownKeys + nested @Serializable GpsSummary/GpsPoint round-trips on wasm (gitlive JS) -- mirror the android shape exactly.
